categories.name: PC
categories.rules:
**BE SURE TO ALSO READ THE GAME RULES!!**

- Video proof is required
- The in-game Time Trial timer is used for submissions. Submit your time in the "Load Removed Time" field. *Do not put anything under "Real Time Attack".*
- ***When submitting, please format your milliseconds as "xx0". Submitting as just "xx" defaults to a millisecond time of "0xx," which is not correct per the in-game time.***

**PC Specific Rules:**

- You must have an FPS counter clearly visible for the entire run to ensure that you are following the FPS requirements. Either the [Steam internal FPS counter](https://ccm.net/faq/40667-steam-display-the-in-game-fps-counter) or an external FPS counter may be used.
- Your FPS must be capped between 30 and 60 FPS. *(NOTE: the game occassionally hitting 1 more FPS above or below limit is normal and fine)*
- Externally altering the framerate cap mid-run with third party software is banned for full-game runs. For Time Trials, you're allowed to change it with the third party software, as long as the game is paused. Altering the framerate cap internally mid-run through the Video Options in the pause menu is allowed.
- Forcibly lagging the game, through any method, for the express purpose of gaining some benefit (e.g. clipping out of bounds, extending hitboxes, etc.) is banned.
- Altering the game in any unintended ways (mods, custom PC skins, music hacks, etc.) is banned
- For Controller Configuration, up to two buttons may be bound to one action. Two or more actions may not be bound to one button, with the exception of binding a movement input + slide/interact to the button of your choosing solely for the purpose of interacting with Coco in Crash 3. Action locations may be changed at will. Keyboard actions may be bound to controller buttons and vice versa, but rebinding the scroll wheel is not allowed. Any further deviations from the default settings (such as creating macros or turbos) are NOT allowed.
